AGENTS · PROJECT

The forks in the road for assistants

Where personal agents are heading, illustrated with Hermes prototypes.

Has anybody already built a personal assistant that keeps up across mobile and desktop?

THE PROJECT · 3 SCREENS

The question

Do we want separate named agents and messy threads, or one assistant that just knows what’s next?

The approach

Win on mobile, design for calm rather than stress, solve continuity with summaries and decision points, treat roles as shared context instead of separate bots, and make real-time voice the default input.

The tradeoff

Personified agents are tempting and may help adoption now, but they are likely a transient phase.

What to take with you

The winning assistant wins on psychology, not just the tech.
